# FG-LLM-0004

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 503 |
| 重大度 | warn |
| Runbook | [`llm-gateway`](../../ops/runbooks/llm-gateway.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `a_request_waiting_past_its_deadline_is_abandoned` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: AI が混んでいて時間内に助言を作れませんでした。AI の助言なしで続けられます。
- en: The AI was too busy to make the advice in time. You can continue without it.
- id: AI terlalu sibuk untuk membuat saran tepat waktu. Anda dapat melanjutkan tanpanya.

## 原因 (cause)

Plan 19 §8.1 (ADR-0017 §3): a request waited in the gateway's queue past its tier's deadline — interactive (a diagnosis, an approval summary) 2 minutes, a review or an autofix 30 minutes, batch 6 hours — without getting a turn: the slot (`llm.concurrency`, default 1) was held by long requests, Kanflow's users kept the shared GPU busy (`ai-busy`: only interactive work starts then), or Kanflow could not be asked (one start per minute). The request is recorded `abandoned`; nothing else stops. Also raised by `forge doctor` `llm.queue_age` with `reason=queued_past_deadline` (`priority`, `age_s`, `deadline_s`, `queued`): a row is still `queued` more than 2 minutes past its tier's deadline — a running gateway would have given it up, so no gateway works the queue (the worker is stopped or stuck; its rows are abandoned after 7 hours). The doctor check is skipped while `llm.enabled` is off.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The worker logs `forge.llm.request_finished` with `error_code=FG-LLM-0004`, `priority`, `deadline_s`, `purpose`, `llm_request_id`. Look at `forge.llm.metrics` (`waiting`, `running`, `forge_llm_queue_wait_seconds{priority}`, `forge_llm_yield_total{reason}`) and `forge.llm.kanflow_gate` state changes around the time; `SELECT priority, state, count(*), max(finished_at - queued_at) FROM forge.llm_requests WHERE queued_at > now() - interval '1 hour' GROUP BY 1, 2`. `forge doctor` `llm.queue_age` lists the oldest wait per tier and warns when requests gave up in the last hour. With `reason=queued_past_deadline`: is the worker running (`systemctl status forge-worker`, its log `forge.llm.gateway_started` / `forge.llm.gateway_disabled`)?

## 対処 (fix)

Runbook llm-gateway: `reason=queued_past_deadline` — start or restart the worker (an approved runbook step in production); the stale rows end `abandoned` and the features ask again. Otherwise a burst passes by itself; a lasting backlog means the shared GPU is too small for both users — raise `llm.concurrency` to 2 only if the GPU has room, move batch work to the night, or give forge its own GPU host (plan 19 §1.1 G3).
